about: teuf-teuf exposure sheet: one record per frame at 24 fps, produced by sim.py (240 Hz substeps). World px, y down. load.affine maps stone-local (x from the rear edge, y up negative from the underside) to world: X = a x + b y + c, Y = d x + e y + f. Logs: centre (x, cy), body angle theta (rad, + clockwise on screen), state. Feet/hands are IK targets with plant/pin state.

white scratched ghost of the stone appears at 1.2 m
declared reset cut to the rollers trial: the load returns to x0 = 0 m
the stone is levered up (3 frames)
log A shoved in under the levered stone (knock)
log B shoved in under the levered stone (knock)
log C shoved in under the levered stone (knock)
the stone settles onto its three logs (tilt spring)
rollers push window opens (tau 0)
log A squeezed out behind the stone's rear lip; kicked back at 5.87 m/s
the log rolls under the pusher's lead foot; he lifts it and re-plants ahead of the log
log A stops on its bark, flat facet down (tok)
the carrier lifts log D (hands pinned to it)
the stone stops at 1.5 m on logs B and C and waits (tau 2.2)
carry window opens (tau 2.2): the load waits on two logs
the carrier sets log D down in front of the stone (wood on stone)
rollers push resumes (tau 4.8)
carry window closes (tau 4.8)
the stone's nose rides up onto log D
the stone stops at 3.0 m (rollers push window closes; soft thud)
white scratched ghost of the stone appears at 3.0 m
declared reset cut to the wheel trial: the load returns to x0 = 0 m
wheel trial push window opens
the cart passes the 3 m roller ghost
the cart stops at 8.0 m (push window closes)
white scratched ghost of the stone appears at 8.0 m
declared reset cut to the counter trial: the load returns to x0 = 0 m
the pusher pulls the axle hold-down pin; the beam lifts away (click)
counter-check push (the wheel trial's input, tau 0-1.6)
the loose rear wheel runs out from under the platform's rear end
the fallen rear wheel stops
the platform's rear end hits the ground (thud), grind begins
the wheel-less load grinds to a stop at 0.948 m
the pusher sits on the forgotten log A; it rocks once (tok)
end source line scratches in
